title: Update Available! (v1.3.4)
description:
🚀 DanieWatch v1.3.4 is now available!

• Double-Tap Watchlist: Double tap any poster to quickly add or remove from your watchlist.
• Perfect Player & Audio Switch: Improved online player stability and seamless audio track switching.
• Supercharged Downloader: Faster offline downloads with enhanced stability and error handling.
• Device Compatibility Fix: Resolved app installation and compatibility issues across devices.
• Performance Boost: Faster loading times and fluid UI animations throughout the app.
